notes.title: Alpha Test: August
notes.content: [h2] [img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1079960730561953792.webp?size=44"][/img] [b]Greetings, everyone![/b][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1375222013467295894.webp?size=44&animated=true"][/img][/h2][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Carnival Hunt[/b] is once again opening its servers for another round of [b]Сlosed[/b] [b]Alpha Testing[/b].[/p][p]⚠️The next [b]Alpha Test[/b] will take place from [b][i]August 18, 08:00 (UTC)[/i][/b] to [b][i]August 25, 08:00 (UTC)![/i][/b] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What’s New in This Update?[/b][/h2][quote][p][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1079960427812880384.webp?size=44"][/img][b]Unfortunately, because of the problems encountered in the last tests with some players' misbehavior, we have adapted our roadmap and introduced the following features:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Ranking System[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]It will work in a compromise mode to maintain matchmaking speed and separate experienced players from newbies. This will allow everyone to enjoy the game to the fullest.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Reporting System[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Will allow players to send reports on game rule breakers. The system is still in development, but already accounts for abuse of the system. Each player will have a limited number of reports they can send, to reduce the amount of indiscriminate and frivolous reports.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Text Chat Filter and Player Muting[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]You can now turn on and off the text chat filter and mute players who are bothering you. You can mute a player so that the message is not displayed in the text chat, to not hear the proximity chat, and also to not see the ping of the player.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Blacklist system[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Allows you to add players to a blacklist. Players added to the blacklist will no longer be caught by you in the lobby.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Penalty System[/b][/h3][list][*][p][i]Previously, any player, if they didn't like something, could just end the game and ruin the game for others. Now there will be a penalty to the search time, which accumulates with each following early exit from the game. Bunnies can only leave the game if: [/i][/p][olist][*][p]The bunny has been killed.[/p][/*][*][p]The bunny is fully discharged and at least 10 minutes of gameplay have passed.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][/quote][quote][p][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1079960860384047184.webp?size=44"][/img] [b]In addition to social systems, we will be experimenting with speeding up gameplay and have therefore made the following changes:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Bunny and Magician movement speed increased by [b]~15%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][i]The speed of the bunny getting up has been sped up significantly to keep things dynamic,[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Some "slow" animations have been sped up by [b]20%[/b],[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Game session time will now be [b]25 min[/b] main session and [b]5 min[/b] end phase.[/i] [/p][/*][/list][/quote][h1][/h1][hr][/hr][h1]|-|-|-|-|-|-|-| [img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1079960380228501614.webp?size=44"][/img] [b]New Roadmap! [/b][img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1079960216747131020.webp?size=44"][/img] |-|-|-|-|-|-|-| [/h1][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/8dd7b1cb369cd363e64d164102563400bdbd36a4.png"][/img][/p][p]To receive more information about the game - [url="https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY"][b]Join us on Discord![/b][/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Alpha Test: May
notes.content:
[h2] 🎪Greetings, everyone!🎪[/h2]
The game announcements is here!

It's been almost a month since the last test, and we've been hard at work polishing old mechanics and adding exciting new ones. These changes should make the game even more thrilling—whether you're playing as the [b]Magician[/b] or one of the mischievous [b]Bunnies[/b]! But let's get to the details.

We originally planned to launch the test earlier, but we wanted to include [b]even more content[/b], so we needed a bit more time.

[h3]The good news?[/h3]
⚠️The Alpha Test will now run for a full week, from [b]May 12, 07:00 (UTC)[/b] to [b]May 19, 07:00 (UTC)![/b]

[h3]What’s New in This Update?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Location:[/b] "Amusement Hall" – a fresh playground for chaos!
[*] [b]Roller Coaster Ride:[/b] Bunnies can now hop on for a wild escape (or just for fun).
[*] [b]Creepy Puppets:[/b] “The Ticketman” will appear at random places in the circus, reacting to the bunnies and revealing their location, but the magician must spend a key to activate them.
[*] [b]Bunny Makeup:[/b] Bunnies can now change their makeup for extra style (or disguise?).
[*] [b]Magician Customization:[/b] A full body and outfit customization system, letting you mix and match parts for a unique look.
[*] [b]New Bunny Objective:[/b] Now the bunnies must find the gears, place in the slots and charge the 2 mechanisms to unlock the last gate.
Tactical Cards: The mage gets new ability cards for more tactical play.
[*] [b]Cage Escape:[/b] The Magician can pull a Bunny out of a cage—but the Bunny will panic!
[*] [b]Promo Codes Live:[/b] Kickstarter backers and VIP (web) supporters will receive exclusive skins redeemable in-game.
[*] [b]Skill Check:[/b] The Magician can now attempt to avoid slipping on marble balls (good luck!).
[/list] ...and much more!

To receive more information about the game - [b][url=https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

Thank you for your patience and support! Stay tuned—bigger surprises are coming soon! See you in the carnival... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/a63f536868fc3f9080a7511fa77c330cb04f5487.png[/img]

notes.title: Alpha Test: March
notes.content:
[h2]🎪Greetings to all [b]Carnival Hunt[/b] visitors!🎪[/h2]

We have some great news for you!

⚠️The [b]Alpha Test[/b] of the game will reopen for all Kickstarter backers and those who purchased Alpha access (support and more details about Alpha access can be found on [b][url=https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY]discord[/url][/b]). The testing period will be [b]from March 6, 23:00 PST to March 9, 23:00 PST[/b]. During this period, we will be testing a lot of new features that have been recently added.

[b]Here's what you can expect:[/b]
[i][list]
[*] Completed procedural room generation system (We will probably expand its functionality in the future). In addition, new rooms will be added every month.
[*] New item: [b]"The Carrot"[/b] - bio-reactive plant that produces thick, vibrant purple-blue smoke when disturbed.
[*] If you're left without energy, after a timeout, you can try a hardcore skill check to get your gears running again and get quite a bit of energy. [u]This is a very controversial mechanic, so it will need to be tested thoroughly.[/u]
[*] Disclaimer prohibiting the game from being broadcast has been changed. But we still ask to specify that the game is still in development to avoid confusion.
[*] The HUD of the magician and the bunny has been changed to achieve a simpler interface.
[*] The customization system will get an update to allow bunnies to change their bodysuit. In addition, the system that was responsible for setting and randomizing customization for dead bunnies has been fixed.
[*] Jack's HUD has been improved to make the user experience easier. (Now you can see what items you can get and how much energy you recover for a certain amount of candy.)
[*] Daily challenges will be available.
[*] Radar has been improved. In addition to displaying distance with an arrow (now more of a visual effect), the radar now highlights items, corpses, and chests with desired items within a radius of the bunny.
[*] Mystic chests that hold gold items have also been added. In the future, you will also need radar to find them. (I.e., the chest will be invisible to the bunnies, but if you use radar near it, the chest will appear.)
[*] The balloon has been modified. Now you can use them to go down to the lower floors without taking damage.
[*] The ropes have been changed. You can use the ropes to get down to the lower floors.
[*] The magician's catch has been changed to a fairer one. (The magician can now safely grab the bunny underfoot and overhead.)
[*] The speed and catch zone size of the magician's hat has been increased.
[*] The skill check of "Panic" has been changed to make players realize that it is a special skill check.
[*] To improve the atmosphere, we've added creepy voices and sounds when the bunny accumulates "Madness."
[*] Prevented the magician's voices from overlapping with each other.
[*] Added a system that prevents too much ping spamming.
[/list]
[/i]
We also frequently receive questions about the release date, and we want to clarify the situation. We have a plan that evolves based on feedback and requests from the alpha testers - the live players. This way, we achieve a fairer game balance and fill the game with only necessary mechanics. The exact release date will be known at least six months before the game is released. At the moment, we are still in the alpha testing stage and plan to transition to the beta test this summer. After that, the release will be right around the corner!

At the end, we would like to thank you for your great patience. And also a special thanks to the friendly community who actively support and participate in the discussion of the project, helping to make the game better!
We also encourage everyone to become an active part of our community to stay up to date on all news and communicate directly with the developers. [b][url=https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY]Join us on Discord![/url][/b]

Thank you for being with us!💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/85959ecf603277b4f8ac1c8fb63ee431a300a15a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update: January 9, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As we step into 2025, we want to take a moment to reflect on what an incredible and busy year 2024 has been for us. Our development team underwent some changes and has been fully focused on bringing our game closer to release. This year, we’re excited to establish stronger communication with our community across all social media platforms and keep you updated every step of the way.

Last year, we successfully launched our Alpha test for Kickstarter backers. The feedback we received was invaluable, helping us improve the game and bring it closer to the experience we want to deliver. Monthly playtests are now a part of our process, and we’ll continue running them until the game’s release to ensure everything is polished and ready.

Currently, we’re in the Alpha stage, but we’re thrilled to share that Beta testing is just around the corner—planned for mid-2025. This means the full release is getting closer, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you all.

For those of you who haven’t joined yet, we want to highlight our [b][u][url=https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY]Discord[/url][/u][/b] server. It’s the heart of our community, where discussions about the game and monthly tests take place. It’s also where players collaborate with our team to shape the game’s future. The community there is incredibly welcoming and passionate, sharing insights, strategies, and even helping to build a [b]Carnival Hunt Wiki[/b]—a resource designed by the players, for the players, to guide newcomers and veterans alike. We are truly grateful for the efforts of everyone involved, including the community members and moderators, for making this possible.

If you haven’t already, we’d love for you to join us in [b][u][url=https://discord.gg/C5MNNgyGNY]Discord[/url][/u][/b] and become part of this amazing journey. Your voice truly makes a difference!

Thank you for taking the time to read this update. We’ll have more news for you soon, and we can’t wait to hear from you in our next test or on our social channels.

See you soon,
The Development Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/e3faeda132fe56d76a7c890a1d9f602a65635485.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Progress Update: September 13, 2023
notes.content:
Hello Carnies!

It's been a while since our Kickstarter campaign concluded, and we understand that you've been eagerly anticipating updates from us. We want to assure you that we're still working diligently to fulfill our promises. In fact, we're thrilled to announce that we'll be providing you with bi-monthly progress updates, and this is our first update for early September. Our commitment to transparency means you'll always be informed about our progress.

We are currently prioritizing the following: 

[olist]
[*] Wrapping up the code for both Magician and his imposter bunny.
[*] Fine-tuning and balancing Magician’s levels.
[*] Crafting distinctive, modular assets for The Sisters’ level.
[*] Designing skill animations for The Sisters.
[*] Implementing the player profile database system.
[*] Finalizing the digital rewards 
[/olist]


Furthermore, we’re delighted to announce that we’ve finalized the 3D models for the new tools unlocked through our Kickstarter campaign. These include the cannon, cannon spark, lost hat, and, as per the enthusiastic choice of our community, the firework rocket. 


We sincerely thank you for your patience and ongoing support. Keep an eye out for our next update and keep sending your suggestions. 


Warm regards,

The Beer Night Team 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/45882f7e06e8edbad64a9136d4489d79892ffe46.jpg[/img]

Bunnies possess a special ability to teleport between two hats using the Lost Hat tool. By placing one hat in a desired location, you can instantly teleport back to it in times of danger or suspense. However, be cautious! The Carnival Monsters have the power to deactivate the first hat you planted. Plan your teleports strategically to outsmart those pesky monsters and ensure a safe getaway!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/5c59d45675e9f508efbf792a93f883b93833da0c.jpg[/img]

Introducing the Radar, a versatile toolbox item that opens a whole new level of exploration in Carnival Hunt. With the Radar in your possession, you gain the ability to locate various entities within the game world. By switching channels, you can choose to track one of three types of things: Jack, the elusive merchant/mechanic who moves around the map, specific items hidden within broken Bunnies, or detect impostor Bunnies among the remains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/d5bbe5affa2639592032e70854210ffedbeeab4c.jpg[/img]

Imagine having the ability to propel your friends to the next floor level and enable fast travel in a forward direction. With the Cannon Spark Plug, you can do just that! This special item allows you to use cannons strategically placed throughout the map. However, there's a catch—you can't use the Cannon Spark Plug on yourself. Instead, you can transfer this incredible ability to your fellow players. Aim the Cannon at your friend, fire, and watch them soar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/8e3fabb3b682ec91d067e0ab03400b8e2ebeca78.jpg[/img]

The Firework Rocket allows you to stun nearby Carnival Monsters temporarily. Moreover, if you manage to hit a monster that has captured Bunnies, "BOOM!" They will be released from its grasp! Timing is crucial, as the Firework Rocket has a cooldown period. Stay vigilant and seize the perfect moment to unleash the rocket and turn the tide in your favor!

[url=https://discord.gg/QhGTJzcMD3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/234b472e7a3b75e2c54ed3de269606ed5e677a43.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.carnivalhunt.com/blog][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36104822/41dd6984aefc3ed170ebe877a345557439972e3b.png[/img][/url]

We're immensely grateful for your unwavering support, and we're eager to hear your thoughts on the game. Join the conversation on our discord server!
